record_type_quote: Here we sought to replicate and extend these results with both masked (invisible) and unmasked (visible) primes.

targets.title: Nobody's watching? Subtle cues affect generosity in an anonymous economic game.
targets.evidence_quote: Based on [21] and [22] we have chosen eyes as prosocial primes, and flowers as a neutral control prime.
targets.outcome_quote: What we may conclude, therefore, is that the effect of eye primes on prosocial behavior does not generalize from the settings used by Haley and Fessler [21] and Bateson, Nettles, and Roberts [22]. Our failure to find an effect is informative about the actual overall effect size, and the conditions in which it occurs [32].
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly judge both studies’ eye-prime effect not to generalize to this new sample. They call the null result informative; their inability to rule out the phenomenon in all contexts is not a verdict that this particular test is uninformative.
